description:
Purpose and Impact:   

 Amentum is a premier global leader in advancing national security, intelligence operations, and mission-critical government programs, delivering innovative engineering and technology solutions where scale and reliability are paramount. Within this mission-driven environment, our data engineering teams operate at the forefront of cloud modernization—architecting, maintaining, and migrating vast, complex data assets that power critical decision-making across national intelligence priorities.

 As a Data Engineer SME, you will lead the evolution of high-throughput data pipelines, enterprise data warehouses, and modern cloud architectures. You will drive the seamless migration of legacy data systems to secure hybrid and multi-cloud environments, ensuring uncompromised data integrity, governance, and real-time accessibility while safeguarding sensitive sources and methods.

 We are looking for engineers who are energized by complex technical challenges and want to build solutions that truly matter. You’ll have the autonomy to shape our technical roadmap, working within a modern, cloud-native tech stack centered on advanced data processing frameworks, distributed storage solutions, automated CI/CD data pipelines, and robust data mesh architectures.

 If you thrive in dynamic, high-impact environments where your code and architecture directly support national-level missions, Amentum offers the perfect platform to push the boundaries of data innovation while advancing your career alongside top-tier technical peers.

 Work Schedule: Typically, Monday through Friday 8-hour days onsite. Flexibility within a 2-week pay period to reach 80 hours.

 Essential Responsibilities: 

 Visual Analytics & Application Leadership: Lead engineering tasks to deliver advanced desktop and web-developed visual analytic software, establishing applications that transform streams of structured and semi-structured data into manageable, actionable intelligence.
 Bulk Analysis & High-Performance Computing: Spearhead the large-scale bulk analysis of relational information by leveraging advanced graphics, visualization frameworks, and high-performance computing capabilities.
 Technology Integration (Open Source, COTS, GOTS): Direct the selection, integration, and maintenance of specified open-source, Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS), and Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) technologies to support advanced analytical workflows.
 Enterprise Database Strategy & Standards: Formulate and drive comprehensive enterprise database strategies, setting rigorous standards for system operations, programming, security, and integration.
 Large Relational Database Architecture: Design and construct large relational databases, seamlessly integrating new systems with existing warehouse structures while refining system performance, query functionality, and scalability.
 Strategic Advisory & Client Consultation: Consult directly with government clients to define needs or problems; supervise studies and lead surveys to collect, analyze, and evaluate data; and provide strategic recommendations and solutions for mission-critical challenges.
 
 Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities): 

 Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI
 Experience: Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in data engineering, database design, software development, or enterprise systems architecture. (Note: In the absence of direct years of experience, exceptional certifications or equivalent past work demonstrating unique expertise may be used to show the required proficiency level). 
 Technical Stack Fluency: Expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, and data processing frameworks, with a deep background in developing data analytics for both desktop and web-based visual analytic applications.
 Database Mastery & Performance: Exceptional expertise in enterprise database strategy, designing and constructing large-scale relational databases, data warehousing, and optimizing complex system performance.
 COTS/GOTS & High-Performance Computing: Extensive experience deploying open-source, COTS, and GOTS technologies, alongside advanced graphics, visualization, and high-performance computing tools for bulk relational data analysis.
 Leadership & Communication: Proven track record of initiating and supervising complex programs, providing technical guidance to program staff, and briefing senior government leadership.
   
 Security Clearance Required: 

 Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
 
 Minimum Education: 

 Bachelor's Degree
 In absence of degree, additional years of experience may be substituted for educational requirements
 
 Minimum Years of Experience: 

 Minimum of 10 years of experience with 6 years of related technical experience
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Agile & Sprint Execution Experience: Deep familiarity operating within fast-paced, 2-week Agile sprint cycles, utilizing tools such as Jira for backlog tracking and Confluence for collaborative documentation.
 AWS Cloud Environment Expertise: Advanced hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing enterprise data pipelines, storage solutions, and analytical workflows specifically within Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud architectures.
 Executive Presentation Skills: Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex technical data analytics and system performance metrics into clear, high-impact presentations for government customers, contract leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.
 Collaborative & Supervisory Acumen: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and foster a high-performance team environment.
 Modern Toolchain & Documentation Mastery: Expert comfort utilizing standard enterprise productivity suites alongside modern engineering toolsets to deliver polished technical artifacts, architecture blueprints, and strategic roadmaps.

 This position is not designated as a safety sensitive position. 

 As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant work environment, Amentum is a drug-free workplace and requires all personnel to comply with company drug and alcohol policies as a condition of employment.  Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the drug screening process.  Please note that this may include pre-hire screening for marijuana, as well as other federally controlled substances due to Amentum’s role as a federal contractor and trusted partner to the US Government.   

 Other Responsibilities: 

 Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.

 Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.
  
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
 Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job.
        
 Compensation Details: 
$200,000 – $225,000        
 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.
  
 Benefits Overview: 
 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:
 Health, dental, and vision insurance

 Paid time off and holidays

 Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

 Educational reimbursement

 Parental leave

 Employee stock purchase plan

 Tax-saving options

 Disability and life insurance

 Pet insurance

  
 Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits. 
        
 Original Posting: 
11/18/2026 - Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs.
        
 Amentum is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our hiring practices provide equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), age, ancestry, United States military or veteran status, color, religion, creed,  marital or domestic partner status, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, low-income status, or mental or physical disability so long as the essential functions of the job can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law. Learn more about your rights under Federal laws and supplemental language at  Labor Laws Posters .
